subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Should the native chat team require an exact current-main replay of delayed, out-of-order chat.history responses before authorizing implementation work?
rationale: The shipped release clearly fails, but current main already contains potentially superseding stale-response safeguards, so source inspection alone cannot establish whether a production defect remains or which reconciliation layer still fails.

options.title: Require current-main replay
options.body: Reproduce the reported overlapping history-response sequence through OpenClawChatViewModel and use that result to define the minimal fix and regression.

options.title: Proceed from release evidence
options.body: Treat the 2026.7.1 device trace as sufficient and implement broader single-flight and sequence reconciliation without first proving the current-main failure.

options.title: Ask reporter to retest main
options.body: Wait for a TestFlight or maintainer build based on current main and request the same tool-run scenario before further engineering work.

recommendation.title: Require current-main replay
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reported overlapping history-response sequence through OpenClawChatViewModel and use that result to define the minimal fix and regression.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently owned and proved the closest shared-native reconciliation change and is best positioned to judge the replay requirement.
